meta.title: Social Organizer — help through people you know
meta.description: Social Organizer shows how you are connected to the people around you. When someone needs help, the request travels along these connections, and small amounts from many add up to what one person needs. Open source, non-profit, holds no money.

hero.title: Help through people you know
hero.lead: Social Organizer shows how you are connected to the people around you: directly, through friends, through friends of friends. When someone needs help, the request travels along these connections, and small amounts from many add up to what one person needs.
hero.sceneAria: A request travels by handshakes, help comes back

steps.title: How it works
steps.s1Title: You are at the centre of your circle
steps.s1Text: Add people you know in person: with a link, or a QR code when you meet. Through them you see the people they know — the second and third handshake.
steps.s2Text: Your people hear it first, then their people. The more people around, the further the signal goes. Everyone decides for themselves whether to take part.
steps.s3Title: Those who respond meet in a chat
steps.s3Text: Each names their own amount and joins the collection chat. Money is handed over in person; the app only shows who is with whom.

hui.title: Six friends, one circle
hui.lead: In southern China such a circle is called a hui. Six friends put in a share once a month. One of them takes that month’s shares. A month later, the next one does.
hui.say: Social Organizer does the same without an organiser and without a queue: the circle is your handshakes, and the shares go to whoever needs them now.

chain.title: A request travels by handshakes
chain.lead: You see Maria’s request because Oleg knows her, and you know Oleg. A request is a question you may leave unanswered. No obligations.

nots.title: What the app does not do
nots.moneyText: Money is handed over in person, in the collection chat. The app shows who is with whom, nothing more.
nots.feeText: Open source, a non-profit project. No subscription, no ads, no cut of collections.
nots.choiceText: Whom to add, how much to give, whether to take part — it is your choice every time. Saying no breaks nothing.

meta.title: How it works — Social Organizer
meta.description: How a share moves in a circle of six friends, why no organiser is needed, and how a request travels by handshakes.

hero.title: Six friends, one circle
hero.lead: In southern China such a circle is called a hui. Six friends put in a share once a month. One of them takes that month’s shares. A month later the next one takes them. There is no organiser: everyone knows everyone.

table.title: How a share moves
table.lead: Tap a month or a name: five shares go onto the table, and one person takes them.
says: Lin takes January’s shares. Five friends put in a share each.
Chen takes February’s shares. Lin puts in a share too.
Mei takes March’s shares. Chen puts in a share too.
Guo takes April’s shares. Mei puts in a share too.
Sun takes May’s shares. Guo puts in a share too.
Huang takes June’s shares. The circle is closed: everyone got it once.

orbit.title: No organiser and no queue
orbit.lead: In Social Organizer the circle is not limited to six. Your friends know their own, and a request travels by handshakes. The shares go not to the next in line but to whoever needs them now.
says: Six people you know. This is the circle: people you have confirmed you know.
Each of the six has their own six. 36 people you do not know, but someone of yours does.
One more step — 216 people. The request reaches them too, through those who know you.
orbit.sumNote: if everyone is ready to give {{share}}

chain.title: Vouching
chain.lead: You only see requests that have a path to you through people you know. Tap a person.
says: Maria Koval asks for help. You do not know her.
Oleg, your brother, knows Maria. That is why he sees her request.
You see the request because you know Oleg. Whether to answer is up to you.

join.title: A new person
join.lead: People join the circle only through someone they know, and only after that person confirms.
says: Katya opens your link and signs in. This is not a connection yet: you get a push.
You confirm: yes, we know each other. Now Katya is your 1st handshake.

del.whenText: Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone. If you had connections, other people’s networks keep “Deleted user” in place of your name, with no personal data. Past collections of other people keep the amounts without your name.
del.noAccessText: Accounts are deleted only from inside the account; there is no deletion by request. If you can’t sign in, the profile is deleted automatically after 2 years without sign-ins. We warn 30 and 7 days before that through Telegram, push notifications and e-mail, whichever the account has.

policy.s1: Social Organizer ("we", "our", "the App") is an open-source mutual support coordination platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our Telegram Mini App and web application at orginizer.com.
policy.s2a: Account data: name, email address, Telegram user ID and username (when logging in via Telegram).
policy.s2b: Profile data: photo, contact information you choose to add (social links, phone number).
policy.s2c: Network data: your connections with other users, invitation history.
policy.s2d: Activity data: support collections you create or participate in, the amounts you name, and your minimum participation.
policy.s3a: To provide and maintain the service — connecting you with your support network.
policy.s3b: To process support requests and track mutual aid within your network.
policy.s3c: To send notifications about collections, invitations, and network activity.
policy.s3d: To improve the App based on aggregated, anonymized usage patterns.
policy.s4lead: We do not sell your personal data. Your data is shared only with:
policy.s4a: Your network members: your name, photo, and contact info you choose to make visible.
policy.s4b: Telegram: data necessary for the Mini App to function within Telegram.
policy.s4c: Hosting providers: our servers process your data to deliver the service.
policy.s5: Your data is stored in a secure PostgreSQL database. We use encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS), JWT-based authentication, and follow industry-standard security practices to protect your information. Accounts with no sign-ins for 2 years are deleted automatically, after notices 30 and 7 days in advance.
policy.s6a: Access your personal data through your profile and settings.
policy.s6b: Correct or update your information at any time.
policy.s6c: Delete your account and associated data yourself in Profile → Account.
policy.s6d: Export your data in a machine-readable format.
policy.s7: Social Organizer is fully open source. You can review our codebase and how your data is handled at <gh>github.com/element1965/Social-organizer</gh>.
policy.s8: For questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, contact us via <bot>Telegram</bot>.

termsDoc.s1: Social Organizer is a free, open-source platform for coordinating mutual support within trusted networks. The App is available as a Telegram Mini App and at orginizer.com.
termsDoc.s2: By using Social Organizer, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
termsDoc.s3a: You must provide accurate information when creating an account.
termsDoc.s3b: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account.
termsDoc.s3c: You may create only one account per person.
termsDoc.s3d: You must be at least 16 years old to use the service.
termsDoc.s4lead: Social Organizer facilitates mutual support by allowing users to:
termsDoc.s4a: Build trusted support networks through personal invitations.
termsDoc.s4b: Create and participate in support collections for people in need.
termsDoc.s4c: Set their minimum participation and track their participation.
termsDoc.s4d: Discover connection paths between network members.
termsDoc.s5a: Create fraudulent support requests or collections.
termsDoc.s5b: Misrepresent your identity or relationship to others.
termsDoc.s5c: Use the platform for illegal activities or spam.
termsDoc.s5d: Attempt to exploit, hack, or disrupt the service.
termsDoc.s6: Social Organizer is a coordination tool, not a financial institution. The App helps organize mutual support but does not process payments directly. All financial transactions happen outside the platform between users. We are not responsible for the fulfillment of support agreements between users.
termsDoc.s7: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use of the App, including but not limited to financial losses from support agreements that were not kept.
termsDoc.s8: Social Organizer is open-source software licensed under its repository terms. The source code is available at <gh>github.com/element1965/Social-organizer</gh>.
termsDoc.s9a: Social Organizer has a zero-tolerance policy toward child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE). We strictly prohibit any content, behavior, or use of our platform that sexually exploits or endangers minors in any way.
termsDoc.s9lead: Specifically, the following are strictly forbidden:
termsDoc.s9b: Sharing, distributing, or soliciting child sexual abuse material (CSAM) of any kind.
termsDoc.s9c: Grooming, trafficking, or exploitation of minors.
termsDoc.s9d: Any communication of a sexual nature with or about minors.
termsDoc.s9e: Using the platform to facilitate access to children for harmful purposes.
termsDoc.s9f: Users must be at least 16 years of age. We reserve the right to immediately terminate accounts and report violators to the appropriate law enforcement authorities, including the <ncmec>National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC)</ncmec> and local law enforcement.
termsDoc.s9g: If you encounter any content or behavior that violates these standards, please report it immediately via <bot>Telegram</bot>.
termsDoc.s10: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
termsDoc.s11: For questions about these Terms, contact us via <bot>Telegram</bot>.
